name: market_s4_ctce
description: CTCE with PPO's clip widened for the joint ratio: clip_param 0.2 x sqrt(13). CTCE clips one ratio, the product of the 13 agents' ratios, so 0.2 leaves each agent a trust region about sqrt(13) times narrower than a DTDE agent's (clip fraction 0.85 against 0.37 in market_s3). Entropy 0.01 / 13 as market_s3_ctce, the baseline.
